messages:

Cc: ProcurementOps <procure@healthspringlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap up -> commercial next steps

Hi David,

Thanks again — our evaluation team wrapped test runs yesterday and we'd like to lock the commercial plan so we can request the PO from procurement. Two asks from my side: a short mutual action plan (MAP) that sequences MSA/DPA/order form activities and a concise list of what evidence (SOC2, data flow diagrams, contractual addenda) procurement will require to approve the vendor.

Target go-live for the pilot is Sept 1; procurement wants to confirm a signature/PO timeline at least 3 weeks prior. Can you share a draft MAP and an attachments checklist we can hand to our vendor approval committee?

Thanks —
Lisa
Lisa Torres
Head of Integrations
HealthSpring Labs

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Torres <lisa.torres@healthspringlabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap up -> commercial next steps

Lisa — good news, congrats to your team on finishing the eval. Attached is a first-pass MAP and an evidence index. High level:

- We recommend parallel review of the MSA and DPA where possible (legal + security), while the order form is finalized in procurement.
- Critical gating items: indemnity & liability caps, data residency statement (we can add a short addendum), KMS/HSM key management notice, and SOC2 report + summary.
- Fallback lane: a limited pilot SOW/order form with an accelerated acceptance schedule that shortens procurement review for pilot-only commitments.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (tabbed by phase & owner), evidence-index.pdf (SOC2 pointer + architecture diagram). Also adding HubSpot link to the deal and a DocuSign quick-sign for a simple pilot order form if you want to expedite.

Proposed milestone timeline (draft):
- 8/06: Internal sign-off on MAP and evidence pack (we'll aim to finalize these today)
- 8/10–8/17: Legal review window (MSA + DPA comments)
- 8/18–8/24: Procurement finalizes order form and issues PO
- 8/25–8/27: DocuSign & payment cadence -> target signature by 8/27

If procurement must push signature out, we can route for an interim pilot order with capped exposure.

I'll loop Karthik on the legal specifics. Next step: quick triage call tomorrow to assign owners?

Best,
David Kim
Sr. Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Torres <lisa.torres@healthspringlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap up -> commercial next steps

Lisa / David — quick legal thread. I scanned the draft MAP and flagged a few sequencing items (comments inline in the attached MAP-draft-v1.xlsx):

1) Parallelization: we can review MSA and DPA concurrently provided the customer accepts a short review SLA (5 business days) for each round of comments. This reduces calendar time by ~7–9 days compared to strict serial review.
2) Indemnity & caps: HealthSpring's procurement often requests higher caps; propose we offer a middle ground with a capped liability to the contract value for pilot. For enterprise scope we can surface revised caps in signature play.
3) KMS addendum: if you require customer-controlled keys, that's an addendum and will add ~10 business days. If HealthSpring is fine with Redwood-managed KMS with contractual language & audit support, we can keep original timeline.
4) Data residency clause: confirm region (us-east vs eu-west). If US-only, minimal changes; if EU residency required we'll need DPA revision and potential routing to Private deployment team (extra 2 weeks).

Action items I suggest we capture in the MAP explicitly: legal SLA per round, procurement acceptance checklist (SOC2 + attestation + vendor questionnaire responses), owner for each evidence item, and fallback pilot-order form text.

If procurement insists on a PO before legal signature, we need an internal procurement hold harmless memo — we can provision that but it requires internal approvals. Happy to discuss on the call.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment(s): MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (comments), evidence-index.pdf

From: Lisa Torres <lisa.torres@healthspringlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcurementOps <procure@healthspringlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap up -> commercial next steps

Thanks Karthik — helpful notes. A couple of procurement constraints to make explicit: 

- Our vendor approval committee needs SOC2 Type II plus a short attestation that the tech and data flow meet our PHI handling expectations. If Redwood provides a redacted SOC2 and an architectural diagram callout, that will accelerate approval.
- PO lead time: from our side, procurement needs at least 10 business days after receiving the final order form to process a PO. So for a target signature by 8/27 we need the final order form to be locked by 8/13.
- Budget window: my finance team has a close on 8/31 — any invoices expected after that will fall into the next spend cycle. Pilot funding is on this quarter's budget but the full contract needs to align with next quarter unless we finalize before 8/31.

Can you convert the MAP into the short two-column checklist procurement prefers: Action | Owner | Target Date | Artifact? If we can get that by EOD tomorrow we can run it past the committee on Friday. Also request: evidence-index with SOC2 redaction and an architecture diagram labeled for procurement review.

Lisa

Hi all — consolidated and attached: Purchase-Checklist-vFinal.pdf is the two-column action checklist (Action | Owner | Target Date | Artifact) and I updated the MAP-draft-v1.xlsx with the legal SLA rows. Per Lisa's procurement timing note, I've reworked the dates to target an order-form lock by 8/12 to give HealthSpring 10 business days for PO processing.

Key notes in the final checklist:
- David: confirm whether Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable; if yes, mark KMS addendum Not Required and we keep the shorter timeline.
- Karthik: send the redacted SOC2 and a one-page architecture callout for procurement (Karthik -> Evidence-index redacted).
- Lisa / ProcurementOps: confirm the signature + PO date window and whether pilot can be covered under a separate pilot order form if full contract timing slips.

I'm scheduling a 30-minute triage tomorrow 9:00 AM PT to walk the checklist and assign final owners. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=meet-redirect-20260806

Thanks — attaching Purchase-Checklist-vFinal.pdf and a cleaned MAP-draft-v1.xlsx. If everyone confirms the owners by EOD we'll publish the final MAP to the HubSpot deal record.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
